# Prototype Images

Photos of the inventor's own prototype: a standard twist-on wire nut combined with separately purchased heat-shrink tubing (parts from Harbor Freight).

**IMPORTANT:** The two current images are AI-edited (studio-style background added from original photos). Any printed text on the sleeves (e.g. "E203950", "DR223344") was generated by the editing tool and is NOT a real marking or UL file number. Do not use these in patent filings, test records, or buyer pitches. Replace with the original unedited photos.

|---|---|
| `reference_lineup_yellow_blue_sizes.jpg` | AI-edited: yellow (large) and blue (small) wire nuts with black heat-shrink sleeves, plus a loose length of tubing. |
| `reference_installed_on_wire_with_tubing.jpg` | AI-edited: yellow wire nut with shrunk-on black sleeve over a spliced pair of black zip-cord conductors, next to stripped copper leads and an unshrunk tubing length. |
